title: Marketing & Branding
completion_message: ¡Magnífico! Dominar el vocabulario de Marketing y Branding te permite hablar con autoridad sobre cómo posicionar una empresa en la mente del consumidor.

parts.visual:
Posicionamiento: 
- Brand awareness (Reconocimiento de marca - qué tan conocida es). 
- Market share (Cuota de mercado - porcentaje de ventas totales). 
- USP (Unique Selling Proposition - Propuesta Única de Venta). 
Ej: To increase our market share, our USP must create strong brand awareness.
parts.audio: Positioning. Brand awareness is how recognizable your brand is to the public. Market share is the percentage of total sales your company has in an industry. U S P stands for Unique Selling Proposition, what makes you different. For example: To increase our market share, our U S P must create strong brand awareness.

parts.visual:
Estrategias de campaña: 
- Target audience (Público objetivo). 
- Niche market (Mercado nicho - segmento pequeño y especializado). 
- Word of mouth (El boca a boca - recomendación orgánica). 
Ej: Our target audience is a niche market. We rely heavily on word of mouth.
parts.audio: Campaign Strategies. Target audience is the specific group of consumers you want to reach. A niche market is a small, specialized segment. Word of mouth is organic recommendation between people. For example: Our target audience is a niche market. We rely heavily on word of mouth.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término correcto de marketing.

questions.question: We need an advertising campaign to build brand ____. (Reconocimiento/Conciencia de marca).
questions.explanation: Brand awareness = reconocimiento de marca por parte del consumidor.

questions.question: Our goal is to capture 20% of the market ____ this year. (Cuota de mercado).
questions.explanation: Market share = cuota o participación de mercado.

questions.question: What makes our product different? What is our ____? (Propuesta única de venta).
questions.explanation: USP = Unique Selling Proposition (Propuesta Única de Venta / Valor).

questions.question: We are targeting a very specific ____ market: vegan athletes. (Nicho).
We don't pay for ads; our growth comes from ____ of mouth. (El boca a boca).
questions.explanation: Word of mouth = publicidad de boca en boca.

questions.question: Before launching, we must clearly define our target ____. (Público/Audiencia).
The logo, colors, and voice are all part of the brand's ____. (Identidad).
We are going to ____ the product to attract a younger audience. (Reposicionar/Renovar).
questions.explanation: Rebrand = cambiar o renovar la marca (logo, imagen, etc).

questions.question: The marketing ____ outlines all our promotional activities for the year. (Plan/Estrategia).
The new iPhone commercial went ____ on social media. (Viral).
We need to analyze consumer ____ to understand what they want. (Comportamiento).
A ____ group was organized to test the new flavor. (Grupo focal).
questions.explanation: Focus group = grupo focal (para estudios de mercado).

questions.question: Offering a free trial is a great ____ to get new users. (Incentivo).
Nike's 'Just Do It' is a famous marketing ____. (Eslogan/Lema).
We hired an influencer for product ____. (Posicionamiento/Colocación del producto).
questions.explanation: Product placement = colocación de producto (en videos, películas, etc).

questions.question: To retain customers, we launched a ____ program. (Programa de lealtad).
questions.explanation: Loyalty program = programa de lealtad (puntos, recompensas).

questions.question: The price point is too high. We are pricing ourselves out of the ____. (Mercado).
questions.explanation: Price out of the market = poner un precio tan alto que nadie compra.

questions.question: We need a PR campaign to improve our corporate ____. (Imagen).
Cold ____ is when you phone potential clients who haven't asked to be contacted. (Llamadas en frío).
Our new software has a strong competitive ____. (Ventaja competitiva).

stages.title: Written Expression

A ____ market. (Nicho con N)
Target ____. (Público con A)
____ of mouth. (Boca a boca con W)
Brand ____. (Identidad con I)
To go ____. (Hacerse viral con V)
A ____ group. (Grupo focal con F)
Competitive ____. (Ventaja con E)
